Local vehicle-care needs

Professional care near Norwich.

Norwich vehicles face year-round traffic film, winter road contamination, tree residue and everyday interior wear. Our structured services make it easy to choose a suitable level of cleaning or correction without paying for work the vehicle does not need.

Because Norwich customers are already close to the studio, the facility works equally well for shorter maintenance appointments and longer correction or coating projects. Public and trade users can also hire the indoor bay when they want to complete the work themselves with professional equipment around them.

Visiting Auto Opulence

Our facility is at Unit 7 Consensus House, St Faiths Road, Norwich, NR6 7BW. Every appointment is confirmed in advance so the right time, equipment and service can be prepared for your vehicle.

St Faiths Road is in north Norwich. Your confirmation will include the appointment time, selected treatment and the information needed for vehicle handover at Unit 7.

Real workshop result

BMW E21 3 Series Restoration Detail

This factory-original BMW E21 3 Series arrived with its original paint, glass, matching numbers and original dealer-supplied number plates. Although the 45-year-old car had clearly been cared for, decades of use had dulled its red paintwork and marked the light interior. Over 18 focused hours, Auto Opulence deep-cleaned the cabin, corrected the paint, detailed the engine bay and applied Gyeon ceramic protection while respecting the car's originality.

This is a genuine Auto Opulence project completed at the same Norwich facility used by customers travelling from Norwich.

Norwich FAQs

Before you travel.

Where is Auto Opulence in Norwich?

Auto Opulence is at Unit 7 Consensus House, St Faiths Road, Norwich, Norfolk, NR6 7BW. Appointments are confirmed before arrival so the correct bay time can be reserved.

Can I hire the Norwich detailing bay and do the work myself?

Yes. Public and trade bay-hire options are available, with indoor washing, drainage, professional lighting, spotless water and specialist equipment included according to the selected package.

Can I leave my vehicle for a longer treatment?

Yes. Paint correction, restoration and ceramic-coating work is planned as a longer appointment. Vehicle handover and collection timing are agreed when the booking is confirmed.

Can I confirm the price before visiting?

Yes. Choose the service and vehicle size when enquiring. We will confirm the appropriate package, price and expected working time before the appointment.
